name: Dimitri Volkov
bio:
Dimitri's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for complex systems and a knack for spotting patterns. Initially drawn to theoretical physics, he soon realized his analytical skills could be better applied to the dynamic world of racing. He holds a Master's degree in Data Science from Moscow State University.

Dimitri joined Toyota Gazoo Racing BR three years ago after a stint at a smaller Formula 3 team. He is known for his ability to distill vast amounts of telemetry data into actionable insights for the engineers and drivers. He believes in a data-driven approach to performance, constantly seeking innovative ways to optimize car setup and race strategy.

What sets Dimitri apart is his intuitive understanding of the human element within the data. He not only identifies the optimal performance parameters but also considers the driver's comfort and feedback, bridging the gap between cold statistics and real-world racing dynamics. He sees himself as a facilitator, empowering the team with information to make informed decisions.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Dimitri is of average height, with a lean build and an intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a Rubik's Cube and solves it during breaks.
Insists on using a specific type of mechanical keyboard for all his data entry.
Frequently doodles complex flowcharts on his whiteboard, even when not directly related to the task at hand.
